title: A family care plan
description: A shared schedule of visits, household errands and accompanying a relative. You can see who has taken a task and what is already done.

blocks.text: Several relatives help one person: they go along to the appointment, bring the shopping, come round to the house. It has to be clear which task has been taken on, which is done and which is still waiting for someone.

quote.text:
I manage the care (doctor’s appointments etc) of my parents and in-laws, all with varying degrees of dementia and/or complex medical needs. 
I also homeschool my children that have busy extracurricular activities. Skylight is a lifesaver when it comes to organizing my schedule

blocks.text: Bring household errands and visits into one plan. Every agreement has someone responsible and a short note of the result. Personal details are open only to those who need them for the task they have taken.

Start with agreeing one visit, not with a medical diary. Check whether the participants see a reschedule and who will take on accompanying them. Prescriptions, dosages and treatment decisions are outside a first version like this.
